lines.beaver: 오늘 동물원 재미있었어요. 무슨 동물을 봤어요?
lines.beaver_en: The zoo was fun today. What animals did you see?
lines.beaver_roman: oneul dongmurwon jaemiisseosseoyo. museun dongmureul bwasseoyo?
lines.learner: 저는 토끼하고 말을 봤어요. 정말 귀여웠어요.
lines.en: I saw rabbits and horses. They were really cute.
lines.roman: jeoneun tokkihago mareul bwasseoyo. jeongmal gwiyeowosseoyo.

lines.en: Yes, but there were only small fish.

lines.beaver_en: Did you see birds too? I heard them singing loudly.
lines.learner: 네, 새도 봤어요. 닭하고 소도 있었어요.
lines.en: Yes, I saw birds. There were chickens and cows too.
lines.roman: ne, saedo bwasseoyo. dakago sodo isseosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Do you have a pet at home too?
lines.en: Yes, I have a puppy. Its name is Kong.

lines.beaver: 와, 좋겠어요! 저도 동물을 기르고 싶어요.
lines.beaver_en: Wow, lucky you! I want to raise an animal too.
lines.beaver_roman: wa, jokesseoyo! jeodo dongmureul gireugo sipeoyo.
lines.en: Then try raising a rabbit. They're cute.

lines.beaver_en: There were lots of flowers at the zoo too, right?
lines.en: Yes. Lots of roses were blooming at the zoo.

lines.beaver_en: Right. They smelled nice too. Did you see the rose of Sharon?
lines.en: Yes, the rose of Sharon was blooming. The leaves were pretty too.

lines.beaver_en: I saw an apple tree too.
lines.en: Me too. It had lots of apples on it.

lines.beaver_en: If we plant apple seeds, will a tree grow?
lines.en: Yes, it will grow. I want to plant some too.

lines.beaver_en: But there were so many mosquitoes today, it was rough.
lines.en: I hated the mosquitoes, but it was fun. Let's come again!
